Ms Shahana Huda is talking to the students about a new kind of shop.
Shahana ~- You can buy any stationery items here, like pens, pencils,
notebooks, coloured paper, in fact, everything you need for
writing and drawing. You can also buy some food items, like
biscuits, buns, bananas, bottles of mineral water and some
other necessary things. You can also buy your school uniform
and other clothes. There are a number of benefits of this
shop. You don’t have to bargain or haggle with the
shopkeeper over the prices of anything.
